note: The 12 cycles of audit/2026-11-24/reference/reference_trace_BE_hex_v0.3.json, copied field for field. One change: the retired status PROPOSED_UNSOURCED is written PROPOSED with unsourced true and legacy_status kept. No period, source or parent was added or changed. These are the cycles of one trace (honeybee comb), not a registry of every cycle in the database.

cycles.name: circle→hexagon transition
cycles.period_text: ≈6 s fully heated; ≈36 s partially heated
cycles.note: A relaxation, not a repeat. Recorded as a transient phase inside the comb-building cycle; whether it counts as a cycle in its own right is an owner call.

cycles.name: daily activity (circadian)
cycles.period_text: ≈24 h endogenous; free-runs slightly off 24 h in constant conditions; entrains to light–dark cycles; period ≈24 h at both 23 °C and 31 °C (temperature-compensated)
cycles.note: v0.2 (2026-11-24): sourced. The same clock drives time memory and sun-compass compensation (Beier & Lindauer 1970 as reported). External driver: the light–dark cycle.

cycles.name: wax-gland age window
cycles.period_text: begins <1 wk, peaks ≈2 wk (≈day 12), declines after day 18
cycles.context: worker life stage; swarm regime overrides (all ages build)

cycles.name: colony annual cycle
cycles.period_text: 1 year (winter cluster vs summer energy partition)

cycles.name: mānuka flowering window
cycles.period_text: usual 10–12 weeks; 4 weeks in a short season (MPI 2018); 6–12 weeks, often less, Sept–March, <6 weeks in Taranaki (Landcare)
cycles.note: period_s set to 8 weeks as a midpoint for ordering only; the record keeps the range.

cycles.name: mānuka flower nectar stages
cycles.period_text: opening → end of nectar flow; >2-fold changes in sugar, DHA and DHA:sugar across stages
cycles.note: Duration in days not given by these sources.

cycles.name: multifloral forage season
cycles.period_text: union of many species' flowering windows
cycles.note: No source describes the combined window; kept as a structural placeholder.
